intuition: Multiple forward levels let searches skip over many sorted values before descending to the next level.

brute_force.approach: Keep values in a linked list and traverse from the head for each search, insertion, or removal.
brute_force.time: search O(n), add O(n), erase O(n)

optimal.approach: Use randomized skip-list levels so expected searches and pointer updates visit logarithmically many nodes.
optimal.time: search O(log n) expected, add O(log n) expected, erase O(log n) expected

edge_cases: Duplicate values may be stored and erased one occurrence at a time.
Searching or erasing an absent value does not modify the structure.
